summary: First-party Tajikistan discovery identified Geoportal.tj and the State Committee for Land Management and Geodesy. The Geoportal redirected to HTTPS but normal TLS verification failed on an expired certificate. An official public registration/encumbrance page was reachable but did not expose parcel geometry. No safe native parcel ID-plus-polygon response was qualified.
custodian: The State Committee is a national land-cadastre and immovable-property-registration custodian. No Kulob-local registry custodian or functioning city-local public parcel geometry service was evidenced.
requests: Separate English and Tajik discovery, official page requests, Geoportal HTTPS and HTTP-redirect checks, and the official public registration list are recorded in the city record. No TLS bypass, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe owner/contact/titleholder fields were used.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
full parcel polygon geometry only when safely returned
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [37.9157895096194, 69.7917670391339] and population 184502 persons are preserved.
TLS failure, unavailable viewer, or no exact-point response is not treated as citywide absence.
No raw source-specific attributes or GeoJSON sample were retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission.
uncertainty: Geoportal data may be available after certificate remediation or through a different official route; no exception was used.
Native parcel IDs, CRS, polygons, and citywide coverage remain unverified.
The official registration list is not a substitute for a parcel geometry service.
